verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is a payments and commerce platform for AI-agent checkout. A platform of this kind could plausibly offer versioned, reviewable, and reversible configurations or flows, so the axis applies. The evidence covers tokenization, ACP/UCP checkout flows, product feeds, an MCP server, and webhooks, but nothing about versioning, reviewing, or rolling back user automations. Session cancel and commit are checkout operations, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
